subject: Clarify: marketplace addendum — invoice waterfall, pass-through attestation & EDI sample
messages:
From: Carolyn Vega <carolyn@skylinecloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure-skyline@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft addendum questions: invoice waterfall and attestation

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Our procurement team reviewed the draft reseller addendum you sent (attached) and has two things they need clarified before we can proceed to routing:

1) Invoice waterfall / fee flow: The draft references "pass-through charges to end customers" but doesn't show a sample invoice layout. Our AP team needs to confirm how Redwood fees will appear on Skyline invoices for co-sold transactions (line items, tax treatment, and our reseller margin). Can you provide a sample invoice or an EDI mapping?

2) Pass-through attestation: Procurement is asking for a simple attestation we can include with our invoices that certifies the pass-through nature of the fees (for audit). Is Redwood comfortable providing a short attestation clause and a signature block, or would you prefer an attestation letter on company letterhead?

I attached the Skyline redlined copy of the addendum (Skyline_Draft_Addendum_v3.pdf). Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Carolyn Vega
Head of Partnerships | Skyline Cloud Solutions
[Attachment: Skyline_Draft_Addendum_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Vega <carolyn@skylinecloud.com>
Cc: Procure Team <procure-skyline@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft addendum questions: invoice waterfall and attestation

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the note and the redlines.

We're happy to provide both: (a) a sample invoice template / EDI mapping for your AP team, and (b) a concise pass-through attestation that Skyline can attach to invoices. I'm looping in our partners lead and ops (karthik) and revenue ops (ben) to confirm the exact fields we'll populate in the sample invoice and any commercial constraints. Marissa from legal/commercial is cc'd for the wording of the attestation.

Action items for us:
- I will circulate a proposed CSV invoice sample and an EDI field mapping (next business day).
- Marissa / Ben: can you confirm whether Redwood should provide a signed letterhead attestation vs an embedded clause? Any legal exposure we should surface?

Would you prefer to get the materials in a single package or as separate files (attestation + invoice sample)?

Best,
Hannah
Account Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Skyline ask — invoice layout + attestation wording

Karthik / Marissa — quick sync note on Skyline (DL-2027-0987-SKY). Carolyn asked for: an invoice example (how fees show up), an EDI/CSV mapping for AP ingestion, and a simple attestation for pass-through charges.

Context: this is a marketplace reseller relationship; Skyline will be reselling subscriptions and will list Redwood unit charges as pass-through on their customer invoices. They want the attestation for their audit trail and to satisfy internal PROC requirements.

Questions:
- Commercial: Karthik, do we permit line-level pass-through without Redwood branding? Will there be a reseller margin line we need to account for? Will tax handling differ regionally? Please outline the fields you expect (unit price, description, Redwood model name, Redwood fee code, reseller margin, total).
- Legal: Marissa, do we have any objections to signing a short attestation (one paragraph + signature) attesting the pass-through nature and that Redwood will provide records on request? Any indemnity implications?

I put together a draft CSV that mirrors what Skyline asked for (attached). Ben — can you review the invoice sample and confirm whether it matches our billing export fields?

Thanks,
Hannah
[Attachment: redwood-pass-through-spec.md; sample-invoice-template.csv]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 11:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Skyline ask — invoice layout + attestation wording

Thanks Hannah — quick answers below, edited inline: 

- Reseller margin: Skyline can show a reseller margin line but Redwood prefers to be listed as a separate pass-through line (no markup applied by Redwood). We don't require branding removal; whatever the partner prefers is OK commercially.
- Fields to include in sample invoice/EDI: invoice_id, invoice_date, sku, product_description, quantity, unit_price, redwood_fee_code, redwood_description, reseller_margin, subtotal, tax, total, customer_reference_id.
- Tax handling: for US-based customers Skyline is responsible for sales tax collection — Redwood will provide tax classification codes on request but will not calculate resale tax on Skyline's behalf.

I attached a quick mapping and a proposed sample row. From a sales perspective, ensure the redwood_fee_code lines map to the consumption line in our export; Ben, confirm whether fee_code -> model_name mapping is stable for the quarter. If not, we need to version the mapping we give to theirs.

Karthik
Director, Channel Partnerships
[Attachment: sample-invoice-template.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Skyline ask — invoice layout + attestation wording

Looping in final legal guidance. Short version: we can provide an attestation paragraph embedded in an invoice or a signed letterhead — both are acceptable. Prefer embedded attestation to reduce paperwork. Proposed language (one paragraph):

"Redwood Inference hereby certifies that the amounts identified as pass-through charges on this invoice represent fees billed to Skyline Cloud Solutions for services consumed by Skyline's end customers and do not constitute a fee retained by Redwood beyond the amounts invoiced herein. Redwood will maintain records of usage and invoiced amounts and will provide such records to Skyline upon reasonable request for audit purposes."

Notes / redline suggestions:
- Avoid open-ended indemnities tied to pass-through wording. If Skyline requests additional indemnity for their resell, push back or tie to specific breach scenarios.
- Limit the attestation to the invoiced period and include a records request window (e.g., Redwood will retain records for 24 months).

Ben: one operational ask — please confirm the retention window and whether we need to reference SOC 2 logs or simply usage exports.

Marissa
VP, Legal & Commercial

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Carolyn Vega <carolyn@skylinecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Procure Team <procure-skyline@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft addendum questions: invoice waterfall and attestation

Hi Carolyn — thanks for your patience. Attached are the materials we discussed: (1) a proposed one-paragraph attestation you can embed on Skyline invoices, (2) an EDI/CSV sample mapping with a sample row, and (3) a short spec describing the export field definitions.

Summary: 
- Attestation: we recommend the embedded paragraph (see attached). Redwood will retain usage and invoice records for 24 months and will provide them to Skyline on reasonable request for audit. If Skyline prefers a signed letterhead attestation instead, we can produce that as a follow-up.
- Invoice layout: include a dedicated "Redwood Pass-Through" section with the following fields: redwood_fee_code, redwood_description, unit_price, quantity, subtotal. Reseller margin should be listed as a separate line. Tax responsibility remains with Skyline for US customers.
- Versioning: the fee_code -> model mapping is stable through Q3 2027; if Redwood changes mappings, we will publish a new mapping file and include a version header in the export.

Next steps: can your AP team confirm whether the CSV sample meets their ingestion requirements and whether the attestation language is acceptable for procurement? If yes, we can incorporate the agreed wording into the addendum and push the redline back to Skyline legal.

Attachments:
- redwood-pass-through-spec.md (field definitions and versioning notes)
- sample-invoice-template.csv (one sample row + headers)
- proposed-attestation.txt (one-paragraph wording)

Thanks — happy to do a short handoff call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Hannah
Account Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood-pass-through-spec.md; sample-invoice-template.csv; proposed-attestation.txt]
